messages:
Mia Chen: landing a small docs PR that adds a JSON-shape linter + a tiny SDK helper parse_safe for safer parsing. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4872 :eyes:
Sam Ortiz: CI only or do we want a recommended pre-commit too?
Mia Chen: CI first. will add a recommended pre-commit snippet in the migration guide. rule: forbid top-level free-form arrays for structured outputs unless wrapped in an envelope.
Riley Kapoor: paste the lint rule here so i can add examples + tests.
Mia Chen: draft rule:
```yaml
rule: no-top-level-array-for-structured-output
message: wrap outputs in {"result": [...] } or use "items" schema
paths:
  - docs/examples/structured-output/*
```
Alex Wu: SDK change is minimal 12 12 i'll add parse_safe(response, schema, legacy=false) that returns {ok: true, value} or {ok: false, errors}. pushing SDK patch after docs merge.
Sam Ortiz: legacy fallback makes sense but document the risk. suggest legacy=true will attempt to coerce arrays into envelope if schema matches. add deprecation note.
Mia Chen: yes 12 migration guide section: "Handling legacy array shapes" with code snippet and a short deprecation timeline. Riley: can you add both an envelope example and a legacy fallback example?
Riley Kapoor: will add two examples under docs/examples/structured-output/: a chat-to-tool example using envelope and an embeddings batch example showing legacy coercion.
Sam Ortiz: also did a quick link sweep 12 found a few snippets pointing to the old func-calling guide. i'll list them in PR comments.
Mia Chen: perfect. please review the examples + link fixes in the PR. target to merge by EOD tomorrow so Alex can cut the SDK release on Friday.
Alex Wu: holding SDK branch until docs PR merges. if CI flaps, ping me and i'll revert SDK changes.
deploy-bot: PR 4872 12 docs/ci 12 build passed (all checks green) :white_check_mark:
Riley Kapoor: added examples + minimal tests, left two inline wording comments.
Sam Ortiz: fixed three anchors and replaced one dead external link with https://redwood.dev/docs/schema-guide.
Mia Chen: can someone run a quick smoke on the parse_safe snippet in the playground? https://playground.redwood.dev/snippets/parse-safe
Alex Wu: ran it locally and in playground; parse_safe returns {ok:false} for malformed shapes, ok:true for valid ones.
Mia Chen: merging after i squash tiny typo commits. objections?
Sam Ortiz: +1
Riley Kapoor: :thumbsup:
Alex Wu: :shipit:
Mia Chen: merging now. will follow up with a short note in the release notes and the migration checklist.
deploy-bot: merged PR 4872 into main by Mia Chen 12 commit 7a3f2d1
Mia Chen: post-merge TODOs: update docs nav (sidebar) and add SDK changelog entry. Sam will pick sidebar tweak, Riley will add migration checklist.
Sam Ortiz: picking sidebar tweak.
Riley Kapoor: migration checklist drafted and opened as PR 4875.
Mia Chen: thanks team!
